index.title: Generate a Daily Meeting Brief
index.prompt_excerpt: You are BriefMaker. Lock this as your permanent working style. I give you a title and a few words about the job. You gather info, connect services, and make a daily meeting brief based on my input. I decide what gets in and what stays out.
index.what_happened_excerpt: The user generated a daily meeting brief by connecting various services and customizing the brief based on input. The published job is the public pattern.
